More Than Just Jewellery

At SHYNWELL, we believe every piece of jewellery is a reflection of your unique story, style and confidence.

OUR BRAND STORY

A Modern Online Jewellery Brand

SHYNWELL was created with a simple vision – to bring beautiful, high-quality imitation jewellery to your fingertips. We are a modern online jewellery brand, designed for today's women who love style, elegance and affordability. Our collection is crafted to help you shine, every day and on every occasion.

OUR JEWELLERY COLLECTION

Timeless Designs for Every Moment

From traditional classics to trendy modern styles, our collection offers a wide range of imitation jewellery for every mood, occasion and outfit. Whether it's a casual day out, a festive celebration or a special event — SHYNWELL has the perfect piece for you.

OUR PROMISE

Quality, Style & Your Satisfaction

We are committed to offering jewellery that looks beautiful, feels special and lasts long. With elegant designs, secure packaging and a smooth shopping experience, your trust means everything to us.

Frequently Asked Questions

What is 1g micro gold plating?

It is a thin layer of real gold (about one gram) applied over a brass or copper base. It gives the rich look of gold at an affordable price, but it is not solid gold.

How do I care for my imitation jewellery?

Keep it dry and away from perfume, sprays, sweat and water. Wipe with a soft cloth after wearing and store each piece in a pouch or box, separately.

What are the shipping and delivery timelines?

Orders are fulfilled through Amazon, Meesho and Flipkart. Delivery typically takes 3 to 7 working days depending on your location and the marketplace.

What is your return and exchange policy?

Returns and exchanges follow the policy of the marketplace where you bought the item, usually within the return window shown on the product page. Contact us if you need help.
